w:r.w:t: The Front Office area in the uploaded Analysis HMS source manages room availability, reservations, walk-in/check-in activity, guest profiles, room settlement, guest ledger/charges, occupancy information and night-audit functions. The project also exposes dedicated reservation and front-office screens.

9. At departure, verify pending charges and use the checkout/billing workflow available to the logged-in role.
10. Run occupancy/guest reports and complete the required night-audit controls.

Run the configured audit process and
• Verify the correct property/company context before entering transactions.
• Use active master records only and keep obsolete masters inactive where the system provides an Active/Inactive option.
• Verify room availability before assigning a room.
• Review guest profile and stay dates carefully before saving.
• Check pending charges/KOT-related status before final bill printing where the screen provides that check.
• Record payment references (cheque, UPI, card and batch information) when applicable and available on the transaction screen.
• Use merge/reverse-merge functions only after confirming the correct source and target folios/rooms.
• Run reports with the correct date range and review the result before printing/exporting.
• Follow property authorization rules for cancellations, bill cancellation, settlement adjustments and folio changes.
